I wrote the game to [index.html](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/three/agyo_game_r1/index.html). It's a single file with no outside dependencies, so you just open it in a browser. I haven't run it in a browser myself, so it hasn't been tested.

- **Controls:** move the paddle with the mouse, the ← → arrow keys, or A / D. Click or press Space / Enter to start, launch the ball and go to the next level.
- **Levels:** Level 1 has simple rows of bricks. Level 2 has a pattern with more bricks that take 2–3 hits, and the ball moves a bit faster. Brick colour shows how many hits are left.
- **Score and lives:** the score, the current level and your lives (you start with 3) are shown at the top. There are start, level-clear, game-over and win screens, and you can restart from the last two.

The ball's bounce angle depends on where it hits the paddle.
